headline: 5 Michigan deals, $396K raised — led by High Street Holdco, LLC

top_deals.summary: High Street Holdco, LLC, a Traverse City-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $2.3M of equity and options/warrants issued to 1 investor.
Kingsbury Pictures LLC, a Sawyer-based company, filed a $650K equity offering under Rule 506(b); $71K sold to 5 investors.
Clubhouse Capital LOVB SF LLC, a Birmingham-based venture capital fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $250K sold to 3 investors. (Amended filing.)
Clubhouse Capital PredictSync LLC, a Birmingham-based venture capital fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $75K sold to 3 investors. (Amended filing.)

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $396K sold across 3 Form D filings this week, down 99% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Kingsbury Pictures LLC (Sawyer, Other) targeting $650K. Good question to ask: are founders in other favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
High Street Holdco, LLC disclosed a deal. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan financial services assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $325K raised so far — led by Clubhouse Capital LOVB SF LLC (Venture Capital Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
